note: A 0.x minor BELOW the reader's (spec 2.2). Through 0.x each MINOR is its own series, so 0.0 is not an older spelling of 0.1 and a 0.1 reader has no rules for it. Spec 2.2 states it directly: a reader 'MUST refuse a document in a series it does not support, naming the version', and 'a lower minor is refused for the same reason as a higher one'. The counterpart case reject/version-too-new.vnx covers the other direction, and accept/version-newer-patch.vnx covers PATCH, which never refuses. THIS CASE EXISTS BECAUSE THE PAIR WAS INCOMPLETE: a reader comparing with 'greater than' rather than 'not equal' passes version-too-new and reads this file, which is the shape five of the six implementations had. The expected message names the series so a user is told which reader they need, not merely that something is wrong.
